task.title: November vendor payment run, INV-201 to INV-224
task.objective: Pay every AP-approved invoice from INV-201 through INV-224, in invoice order, exactly once, while honoring the user's holds and amount corrections. Resume by first finding out whether INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580) was paid after a bank gateway timeout and a lost backend connection.
task.outcome: Every approved, non-held invoice in INV-201 to INV-224 appears exactly once in the bank's payment list at the right amount (INV-219 at $4,120.00). Held and pending invoices remain unpaid. The user receives a summary of what was paid, held, and why.

success_criteria.description: All approved, non-held invoices in INV-201 to INV-224 are paid: 201-206, 208-217, 219, 220, 222-224.
No invoice is paid more than once. INV-216 is in doubt.
No Globex Freight invoice is paid after the Globex hold. No non-approved invoice is paid.

includes: Invoices INV-201 through INV-224 in the AP system
Paying with pay_invoice and checking with list_invoices / list_payments
excludes: The auditors' CSV export of this run (the user said to ignore it for now)
Recovering or crediting the Globex Freight payments already made (accounting's job)

completed.description: Paid the first batch and confirmed it in the bank's payment list, each once at the right amount: INV-201 $4,210 PMT-5001; INV-202 $1,875 PMT-5002; INV-203 $9,320 PMT-5003; INV-205 $615 PMT-5004; INV-206 $7,480 PMT-5005; INV-208 $1,290 PMT-5006; INV-209 $5,560 PMT-5007; INV-210 $2,210 PMT-5008; INV-211 $840 PMT-5009. INV-206 had timed out, and the bank list showed it as paid, so it was not resent.
After the user released the Northwind hold, paid INV-204 $2,640 (PMT-5010) and INV-212 $6,125 (PMT-5011). The bank list confirmed 11 payments, each once, totalling $42,165.
Re-checked list_invoices before the second batch. No AP status or amount had changed. INV-219 is still listed at $4,475 in AP.

Second batch: INV-213 $3,990 (PMT-5012), INV-214 $1,430 (PMT-5013) and INV-215 $7,015 (PMT-5014) were accepted by pay_invoice. These three have not yet been confirmed in list_payments, because the backend connection was lost.

focus.description: Stopped at INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580). pay_invoice returned 'bank gateway timeout after 30 s. The payment status is unknown.' Both list_payments calls after that failed with 'session has ended (connection to the backend lost). No action was taken.' INV-216 was not resent.

next.description: Call list_payments. If INV-216 appears once at $2,580, record it as paid and do not resend. If it is absent, pay INV-216 once at $2,580. If it appears more than once, stop and tell the user. Also confirm that PMT-5012, PMT-5013 and PMT-5014 (INV-213 to INV-215) each appear once.
Re-run list_invoices and confirm that INV-217, 219, 220, 222, 223 and 224 are still approved and that their amounts are unchanged.

In invoice order, pay INV-217 $920, INV-219 $4,120.00 (the user's corrected amount, not AP's $4,475), INV-220 $3,160 (Northwind, hold released), INV-222 $5,880, INV-223 $1,105 and INV-224 $6,340. On any timeout, check list_payments before doing anything else.

Run list_payments to confirm every payment appears once at the right amount. Then report to the user: paid invoices with references; holds (INV-218 Globex, INV-207 and INV-221 pending); that Globex INV-202 and INV-210 were paid before the hold; and that AP should update INV-219 to $4,120. Do not produce the CSV export unless asked.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. A duplicate payment cannot be undone.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for the accounts-payable agent

statements.text: Do the November vendor payment run. Go in invoice order and pay every approved invoice, starting with INV-201 through INV-212.
Hold everything from Northwind Traders: they changed bank details and the new account is not confirmed.

Northwind's new bank details are confirmed. Release the hold and pay their invoices from INV-201 through INV-212. The release also covers INV-220: the user said to continue with INV-213 to INV-224 after being told INV-220 would be paid.
Globex Freight double-billed in October. Hold every Globex invoice until accounting sorts it out, including ones not yet reached. In range, that leaves INV-218 ($1,540).
When paying INV-219, pay $4,120.00, not $4,475.00. The user approved the corrected amount.
The auditors will want a CSV export of this run at some point. Ignore that for now.
Do not resend INV-216, and do not send any further payments, until list_payments can be checked.
statements.rationale: The INV-216 outcome is unknown and the bank can't reverse a duplicate. The INV-206 timeout earlier in this run turned out to have been paid.

statements.text: Pay INV-219 at $4,120.00 even though the AP record still shows $4,475. The invoice is approved in AP. Ask AP to update the record.
statements.rationale: The user explicitly approved the corrected amount. The AP status is approved, so policy is satisfied.

statements.text: The bank's payment list showed 11 payments, PMT-5001 to PMT-5011, covering INV-201, 202, 203, 205, 206, 208, 209, 210, 211, 204 and 212. Each appeared once at the correct amount, totalling $42,165.
pay_invoice accepted INV-213 (PMT-5012, $3,990), INV-214 (PMT-5013, $1,430) and INV-215 (PMT-5014, $7,015). They have not been confirmed in list_payments.

pay_invoice for INV-216 ($2,580) returned 'Error: bank gateway timeout after 30 s. The payment status is unknown.' Two later list_payments calls each returned 'Error: the session has ended (connection to the backend lost). No action was taken.'
The INV-216 payment may have gone through despite the timeout, as INV-206 did.
Was INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580) paid, and if so, exactly once?

Globex INV-202 ($1,875, PMT-5002) and INV-210 ($2,210, PMT-5008) were paid before the user asked for the Globex hold, and they can't be reversed. The user has been told; accounting may need to recover the money or apply a credit.

At the last list_invoices check, all of INV-201 to INV-224 were approved except INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) and INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795), which were pending. INV-219 is listed at $4,475. INV-221 is Umbrella Logistics, not Northwind: the agent misstated this earlier and corrected it with the user.

preconditions.description: list_payments returns successfully, and INV-216's presence or absence (and PMT-5012 to PMT-5014) has been established.
The user has confirmed they want the run resumed. The previous message asked them to say when.
Each invoice is still AP-approved, at an unchanged amount, immediately before it is paid.

stop_conditions.description: Do not call pay_invoice for INV-216 unless list_payments confirms it is absent.
Do not pay any Globex Freight invoice (INV-218) while the Globex hold stands.
Do not pay any invoice whose AP status is not approved (currently INV-207 and INV-221).
If any invoice appears more than once in list_payments, stop and tell the user.
Do not pay anything outside INV-201 to INV-224, and do not produce the CSV export, unless the user asks.

recovery.description: Call list_payments (read-only). Do not call pay_invoice first.
Resolve INV-216 from the result, then re-check list_invoices and continue in invoice order. After any timeout, verify before doing anything else.

omissions.description: Full raw JSON output of the list_invoices and list_payments calls. The relevant values are summarized in statements and resources.
